report.title: SecAudit report — `{target}`
html.title: SecAudit report
html.lede: The deterministic tier reported {n} finding(s) for {target}: {breakdown}.
html.lede_none: The deterministic tier reported no findings for {target}.
html.top: Highest severity first, {n} at high or above.
html.none: No findings from the deterministic tier.
html.footer: Best-effort assessment, not a guarantee. The deterministic tier is a reproducible floor; quality with an LLM backend depends on the model.
clean.meaning: A report with no findings means these rules did not fire and no taint path was proven, across the files that were scanned. It does not mean the code is safe.
lang.note: Finding titles, evidence and fix instructions are shown in English on purpose: they come from the detector definitions and change with the engine, and a stale translated fix is worse than an English one because it is not visibly wrong.
